messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PDR-8923 — GPU OOM detected on infer-node-702 (pool: gpu-west2b). nvml reports repeated OOMs and CUDA errors. Logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/pdr-8923
maya: Acked on PD, taking pager. Starting investigation.
maya: Quick summary: multiple `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` within 2m, allocation failures on model-worker pid=1217.
leo: Noted. Any customer-facing 5xxs?
maya: Yes — spike in 502s for a subset of requests to /v1/generate. Telemetry shows ~0.6% error rate over the last 3m (baseline 0.01%).
jamie: Any recent deploys or config changes?
maya: No deploys in last 60m. Autoscaler created a new instance earlier (02:30 UTC) to handle a traffic burst — suspect fragmentation/prefetch interacting with KVCACHE.
priya: Can you grab nvml and dmesg snapshots and paste kernel backtrace? Also TG to check GPU temperature/power.
maya: Pasting snippets:```nvml: GPU 0: alloc failed, free 0.0MB, reserved 16480MB
[pid 1217] CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY at gpu_alloc.cc:312
Backtrace: 0x7f9a.. 0x7f9b..```
leo: Thanks. Could be transient fragmentation. Workaround: set pool to reject new heavy model loads, drain in-flight jobs to healthy nodes.
maya: Initiating `pool:set-evacuation gpu-west2b --mode=drain` now. Also toggling per-instance prefetch from 4->1 for new allocations.
pagerduty-bot: Escalation timer: 12m left before auto-escalate to SRE lead.
jamie: Good. If draining doesn't reduce errors within 5m, we should trigger fallback routing to smaller model variant.
priya: Confirmed temps stable (68C), no thermal throttling. NVML shows fragmentation counters rising.
maya: Drain command succeeded. Evac started: 8 nodes marked draining, scheduler will stop new placements. Monitoring evict rate.
leo: Any evidence of memory leak in long-running process?
maya: Snapshot of worker heap shows persistent growth for one worker handling large-context chat sessions. Killing that worker reduces pressure.
jamie: Can we restart the offending worker gracefully and force a cold start?
maya: Doing a rolling restart of worker-1217 -> restarting now.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: worker-1217 restart initiated by maya.
priya: After restart, allocation failures drop to zero on that host. Error rate on /v1/generate down to 0.08% and falling.
maya: Evac drain still in progress; remaining allocations shifted to other pools. No additional OOMs in the last 4m.
pagerduty-bot: Incident PDR-8923 acknowledged by maya. No escalation triggered.
jamie: Good containment. For follow-up: open a ticket to investigate autoscaler interaction with kvcache prefetch and large-model allocations. Assign to eng-runtime.
leo: Also add a guard: if fragmentation counters > threshold, prevent large-model placement on same GPU.
priya: Agreed. Suggestion: add a short-lived auto-restart of workers that show >80% sustained allocation growth for 10m.
maya: Creating post-incident note and linking relevant logs. Minimal customer impact; affected sessions were retried with fallback in most cases.
jamie: I'll handle the PD incident closure once postmortem draft is up. Great work. :thumbsup:
maya: Handoff to leo for next shift monitoring. Leaving a pinned checklist in the incident ticket.
leo: On it. Monitoring for 30m and will escalate if any regressions.
priya: Thanks team.
incident-bot: :page_with_curl: PDR-8923 status update: contained, monitoring phase.
